title: Aft Compartment Powered Drive Units and Roller Trays — Removal
abstract: Removal of the powered drive units and roller trays from the aft cargo compartment, with the tray tipping precaution and the lining panel handling that the short-pitch tray change depends on.

sections.purpose: This task removes the powered drive units and the roller trays from the aft cargo compartment so that they can be replaced, and records the condition of the tray seats before the new trays go in.
sections.job_setup_note: Do this task with the compartment empty and the ground service bus available so that the drive units can be run to a known position before they are isolated. The trays are heavy and will tip when the end fasteners come out; the lifting frame is not optional. Work from the aft end forward so that the removed trays can be passed out through the door rather than carried over open seats.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the compartment is empty and that no container is on the ramp waiting to load. 2. Run each powered drive unit to its home position from the loading panel, then isolate the loading system and tag the circuit breakers. 3. Remove the cargo lining panels in zones 133, 142 and 145 and put them in a protected position. 4. Disconnect and label the drive unit harness at each unit. 5. Remove the powered drive units, working from the aft end forward, and put them on the transit pallet in position order. CAUTION: THE ROLLER TRAYS ARE HEAVY AND WILL TIP WHEN THE END FASTENERS ARE REMOVED. FIT THE LIFTING FRAME BEFORE THE LAST FASTENER COMES OUT. 6. Fit the tray lifting frame to the first tray. 7. Remove the swaged collars EN728781-4A at the tray joints and discard them; they are not re-used. 8. Lower the tray onto the frame and pass it out through the cargo door. 9. Repeat for each tray, working forward. 10. Do a visual check of every tray seat in the floor for elongation, corrosion and thread damage, and record what you find. 11. Check the outboard latch kit VAL324542-62 at each restraint position for free movement. WARNING: DO NOT STAND IN THE DOOR APERTURE WHILE A TRAY IS BEING PASSED OUT. 12. Cover the open floor.
sections.close_out: Stack the removed trays outside the aircraft in position order. Make sure that no swaged collar is left in the floor channel. Record the removal and the tray seat findings in the aircraft technical log; a seat found elongated must be repaired before the new tray goes in.

type_data.effectivity_note: All SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft; the swaged collar joint applies pre MOD-133480 only

safety_precautions: Isolate the loading system and tag the circuit breakers.
Fit the tray lifting frame before the last fastener is removed.
Do not stand in the door aperture while a tray is passed out.

Any change that moves the trays, whether a shorter roller pitch or a container footprint that needs a tray lifted out of sequence, makes those four steps inapplicable until the task is re-issued. Confirm the installed pitch from the aircraft configuration before the frame is drawn from stores.
